messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: request: renderCSS
parts:
To simplify UI transitions, and to preserve (but hide) disabled inputs, I would like to have a function to manipulate css directly.

for example

output$somecss <- renderCSS({
  list(`div.foo`=list(`visibility`,if(input$useFoo)"hidden"else"visible"))
})

or similar.  Any thoughts?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: request: renderCSS
parts: You could use an htmlOutput with renderUI containing tags$style(...). However, for the specific case of hiding/showing inputs/outputs based on other inputs/outputs, have you looked at conditionalPanel?
